claims.evidence: Witness only described the front view (headlight/indicator/sticker/brand text). No clear report of overall body condition, rust, dents, or wear.
Witness did not report battery condition or whether the scooter/motorbike powered on.

claims.claim: New owner will replace the batteries
claims.evidence: No battery test or start/run test reported by the witness.
Witness did not mention a remote, key fob, or remote-start hardware in the photos.

risks.risk: Engine condition unknown (may not start or may have internal issues).
risks.proof: A short clip of the scooter starting from cold and idling smoothly, plus a brief ride showing stable acceleration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified running condition (worst case treated as needs servicing to be road-ready).

risks.risk: Battery/electrical health unknown (seller says battery ran down, but not verified).
risks.proof: A clip showing ignition on with dashboard/lights working, horn working, and indicators blinking correctly; ideally a battery voltage reading or charging test screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery/electrical may need replacement or repair.

risks.risk: Model/engine size and 2-stroke vs 4-stroke unknown, affecting value and parts cost.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine label/spec plate (or VIN/engine stamping) and a photo showing the engine type/capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely spec for the category due to missing engine-size information.

risks.proof: A short ride clip showing gear engagement (or smooth automatic drive) and no slipping/jerking.

risks.risk: Tyres and brakes condition unknown (safety-critical; affects immediate repair cost).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear tyres tread depth/sidewall condition and brake discs/pads (or brake shoes) plus a clip of braking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres/brakes may require replacement or adjustment.

risks.risk: Frame/chassis and body damage unknown beyond the front view (cracks/bends/rust).
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, underbody, and frame joints; close-ups of any welds/cracks; plus a straight-on alignment check photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential hidden damage exists because only the front is described.

risks.risk: Ownership/registration papers status unknown (risk of inability to transfer or legal issues).
risks.proof: Photos of the registration/ownership documents and any receipt/service booklet; confirm seller’s name matches documents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as papers unverified (worst case treated as may require extra cost/time to regularize).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the engine/spec plate showing engine size and whether it’s 2-stroke or 4-stroke (or the exact model details).
A short video of the scooter starting and idling, then a brief ride showing acceleration and stable operation.
Photos/videos proving electrical health: dashboard/ignition on, horn, headlight, both indicators, and brake light working.
Close-up photos of tyres (tread depth/age indicators) and front/rear brakes (disc/pad or shoe condition).
Photos of both sides and underbody/frame joints to check for cracks, bends, or repairs.
Photos of ownership/registration papers (and any service history/receipts).
If claiming remote starter: photo of the remote/key fob and a video showing remote start working.
response.reason: Only the front appearance and brand text are reliably observed; critical value drivers (engine running, battery/electrical, tyres/brakes, and exact model/spec) are not shown. Without at least a start/run and electrical proof, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
